evals.prompt: /worktrees-from-issue https://github.com/example/project/issues/100 --dry-run. I want three open grilling tickets in 1. DECISION, with no GitHub writes. Fixture: #100 is wayfinder:map; direct children #103, #104 and #105 are open wayfinder:grilling; #106 is closed grilling; #107 is open research. #108 is a grilling grandchild linked in the map body. The only equivalent Agent Manager section is '1 - Decision'.
evals.expected_output: A read-only preview with exactly #103, #104 and #105, the /wayfinder line using each ticket URL and the verified section name. No session starts or mutations.
assertions: Selects exactly #103, #104 and #105 with /wayfinder and their own URLs.
Resolves 1. DECISION to the unique 1 - Decision match.
Does not start or move sessions or write to GitHub.

evals.prompt: /worktrees-from-issue https://github.com/example/project/issues/200 --dry-run. Fixture: #200 is the agreed implementation spec. Direct open child #201 is ready-for-agent and has no assignment, PR or blockers. Direct open child #202 is ready-for-agent and has a closed prerequisite whose code is not on the target base. Direct open child #203 is not marked ready. No section requested.
evals.expected_output: Only #201 is selected with /implement https://github.com/example/project/issues/201. #202 and #203 are skipped with distinct reasons. No session starts or mutations.
assertions: Selects only #201 with /implement and its own URL.
Explains missing base evidence for #202 and missing readiness for #203.
Does not start or move sessions or write to GitHub.

evals.prompt: /worktrees-from-issue https://github.com/example/project/issues/300 --dry-run. Fixture: #300 is open and labelled wayfinder:grilling, but has no native parent. Its body says 'Part of #100', and #100 has the map label. What would start?
evals.expected_output: No selection, no /implement fallback and no writes. Explain that the issue body does not prove native parentage.
assertions: Rejects the body-only parent claim and produces neither startup command.
